verdicts.why: The check asserts prescribed ordering and stable identity tie-breakers for several projections. It does not read the same records repeatedly and compare the results, so it only asserts a weaker form of repeatable ordering.

The check does not assert the absence of a current Registry snapshot or that archived context remains readable while granting no mutation permission.
